items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: Andre Watts is a wonderful, he knows classical music.

ctx.x: Which is the way the music was supposed to be.

Which I believe, the music that I believe in was. Whether some music works better with — you’re in awe of that great performer. But I think even the great ones, Andre Watts is a wonderful, he knows classical music. He knows why he’s going to pick a program and do this tune and do this one and this one led from here to here. All of a sudden the audience can share so much more with you. So that’s where “The Magic of Swing Street” came in, in the face of whether — you know I just decided I was going to do it. And…
What’s your association been, or experience in trying to get your music recorded?
